# Jetpack 1.5 and Squarez Deluxe — original DOS freeware

**Author:** Adam Pedersen / Adept Software

Original complete DOS freeware ZIP:
https://www.adeptsoftware.com/jetpack/jetpak15.zip
Official game pages:
https://www.adeptsoftware.com/jetpack/
https://www.adeptsoftware.com/squarez/

Adept hosts a combined ZIP containing both registered games. It differs from
a historically mirrored ZIP; **never substitute the mirror's checksum**.

Verified author-hosted package, checked by GitHub signed build #38701209570:

- Original ZIP basename: `jetpak15.zip`; **494,745 bytes**
- SHA-256: `03f4979149bdeeb43091517e0f33f92b14cc2e5d7531e0c524749c3383fc9d4c`
- MD5 corroboration: `52d5bc3656f28cfba23029aceffcc95f`
- Jetpack direct executable: `jetpak15/JETPACK.EXE`
- Squarez Deluxe executable: `jetpak15/SQUAREZ/SQUAREZ.EXE`
- Game-specific original data, manuals, and credit files must remain intact.
- Archive integrity, byte length, digest, and both executables are checked at
  build-time by `scripts/fetch-jetpack.sh` (Windows: `.bat`).
- ZIP is intentionally not tracked in Git. The signed APK packages the
  unchanged original ZIP, then the existing private DOS module installer
  independently registers the two runtime roots and control profiles.

This is **copyrighted freeware**, not MIT, open-source or public domain.
Its content is excluded by `-PexcludeJetpack` for commercial release variants
or if distribution permissions change. Follow license and attribution notices
and do not sell original game data or remove its documentation.

ReverieVR Daydream controller defaults:
- Both games: touchpad four held directions => DOS arrow keys.
- Jetpack: touchpad click => held Alt (fly/jump), physical minus/App =>
  Ctrl (phase). Rocker maps Enter/Escape in menus.
- Squarez: click => Ctrl (rotate), minus/App => Alt (place).
- Physical O/Home stays reserved for ReverieVR Quick Menu, never DOS input.

Original archives were validated, but a signed APK and an actual Galaxy S9
Daydream headset launch test remain separate acceptance gates.
